sizeChartHelp.zh: 请输入每个尺码的实测数值。与标准值相差超过 0.5 英寸将自动标记。

generalPhotosHelp.en: Front, back, stitching, overall condition, etc.
generalPhotosHelp.zh: 正面、背面、走线、整体状况等

tagPhotosHelp.en: Washing tag, hang tag, packaging card, barcode, etc.
tagPhotosHelp.zh: 水洗唛、吊牌、包装卡、条码等

issuesHelp.en: Log any defects or non-conformances found during this inspection.
issuesHelp.zh: 请记录本次检验中发现的任何缺陷或不合格项。

noIssues.en: No issues found during this inspection

submitSuccess.zh: 报告已成功提交并发送邮件。

submitError.en: Something went wrong submitting the report. Please try again.
submitError.zh: 提交报告时出错，请重试。

confirmSkipPreProduction.en: Skip the pre-production sample stage for this PO?
confirmSkipPreProduction.zh: 确定跳过此订单的产前样阶段？

stageSkippedHelp.en: This stage was intentionally bypassed for this PO.
stageSkippedHelp.zh: 此阶段已针对该订单被主动跳过。

customNotesPlaceholder.en: Any other observations for this product
customNotesPlaceholder.zh: 本产品的其他观察记录

finalApprovalHelp.en: Clean, final photos for manager review and approval. These are separate from the supporting photos already attached to each check above.
finalApprovalHelp.zh: 供主管审核批准的最终照片，与上方各检查项已附的支持性照片分开。

referenceChartHelp.en: These are the approved standard measurements for this fit. Use them for reference while measuring.
referenceChartHelp.zh: 以下为该版型已批准的标准尺寸，供测量时参考。

resultReasonTolerance.en: One or more measurements are out of tolerance
resultReasonTolerance.zh: 存在超出公差的测量值

resultReasonMinor.zh: 发现3个或以上轻微问题

resultReasonMajor.en: One or more major/critical issues found
resultReasonMajor.zh: 存在1个或以上严重/紧急问题

noIssuesReason.zh: 未发现影响判定的问题

photoRequiredForFail.en: A photo is required for any check marked Fail
photoRequiredForFail.zh: 标记为不合格的检查项必须上传照片

validationIncomplete.en: Please complete all required items before submitting
validationIncomplete.zh: 请在提交前完成所有必填项目

selectFitRequired.en: Please select a fit and enter at least one measurement
selectFitRequired.zh: 请选择版型并至少输入一项测量值

allChecksRequired.en: Please mark Pass, Fail, or N/A for every check
allChecksRequired.zh: 请为每项检查选择合格、不合格或不适用

photoTooLarge.en: That photo could not be processed. Please try a different one.
photoTooLarge.zh: 该照片无法处理，请尝试其他照片。

manageDropdownsHelp.en: Add or remove options for Factory Code, Creator/Brand, and QA/QC Lead. Changes apply immediately for everyone using this app.
manageDropdownsHelp.zh: 添加或删除工厂代码、创作者/品牌方、QA/QC负责人的选项。更改将立即对所有使用此应用的人生效。

backupHelp.en: Download every purchase order, approval, and inspection report as a zip file. Do this before any deploy as a safety net, and periodically even once storage is confirmed working.
backupHelp.zh: 将所有采购订单、审批记录和检验报告下载为一个压缩文件。建议在每次部署前作为备份下载，即使确认存储已正常工作，也建议定期下载。

restoreBackupHelp.en: Upload a previously downloaded backup zip. Any PO it contains that isn't already in the system gets added. Choose below what happens for a PO that already exists.
restoreBackupHelp.zh: 上传之前下载的备份压缩包。备份中系统尚未包含的订单将被添加。请在下方选择遇到已存在订单时的处理方式。

restoreModeIgnore.en: Skip it - keep the current data

restoreModeOverride.en: Replace it with the backup version

dataDirWarningTitle.en: Data storage is not set up correctly

aqlFallbackNotice.en: No lot size was entered, so a simplified pass/fail rule was used.
aqlFallbackNotice.zh: 未输入批量，因此使用了简化的合格/不合格规则。

resultReasonAqlCritical.en: Critical defects exceed the AQL accept threshold
resultReasonAqlCritical.zh: 致命缺陷数量超出AQL合格标准

resultReasonAqlMajor.en: Major defects exceed the AQL accept threshold
resultReasonAqlMajor.zh: 严重缺陷数量超出AQL合格标准

resultReasonAqlMinor.en: Minor defects exceed the AQL accept threshold
resultReasonAqlMinor.zh: 轻微缺陷数量超出AQL合格标准

additionalIssuesHelp.en: Use this for any issue not already flagged in the sections above - not limited to tolerance or placement.
additionalIssuesHelp.zh: 用于记录上述各项检查中未涉及的其他问题，不限于公差或位置类问题。

severityGuideText.en: Minor: within tolerance - we'll accept it. Major: outside tolerance - that unit gets rejected and sent back to the factory to fix. Critical: the entire batch has the issue - the whole batch gets rejected and redone.
severityGuideText.zh: 轻微：在公差范围内——可以接受。严重：超出公差范围——该件产品将被判定不合格，退回工厂返修。致命：整批产品都存在该问题——整批将被判定不合格并要求返工重做。

photoRequiredForDefect.en: Each logged defect needs at least one photo
photoRequiredForDefect.zh: 每个已记录的缺陷都需要至少一张照片

descriptionRequiredForDefect.en: Each logged defect needs a description
descriptionRequiredForDefect.zh: 每个已记录的缺陷都需要填写描述

defectRequiredForFail.en: Log at least one defect for any check marked Fail
defectRequiredForFail.zh: 任何标记为不合格的检查项都需要至少记录一个缺陷

actualSpotCheckHelp.en: Record the percentage actually inspected - this may differ from the recommendation during busy periods.
actualSpotCheckHelp.zh: 请记录实际抽检的比例，繁忙时期可能与建议值不同。

needMoreInfoForRecommendation.en: Select a Creator and enter PO Quantity above to see the recommendation.
needMoreInfoForRecommendation.zh: 请在上方选择创作者并输入订单数量以查看建议。

manageCreatorTiersHelp.en: Set each creator's QA tier (1, 2, or 3). This feeds the AQL recommendation below.
manageCreatorTiersHelp.zh: 设置每个创作者的QA等级（1、2或3）。此设置将用于下方的AQL建议计算。

manageAqlTableHelp.en: For each Tier, Risk, and PO Size combination, set the recommended Point Check % range and Inspection Level.
manageAqlTableHelp.zh: 为每个等级、风险及订单规模组合设置建议的抽检比例范围及检验水平。

manageUnitCostsHelp.en: Rough per-unit cost used to estimate PO order value (PO Quantity x unit cost), which determines the PO Size band above.
manageUnitCostsHelp.zh: 用于估算订单价值（订单数量 x 单件成本）的大致单件成本，从而确定上方的订单规模区间。

defaultTierLabel.zh: 默认等级（适用于未列出的创作者）

aqlNeedLotSize.en: Enter a PO quantity above to calculate the required sample size and AQL thresholds.
aqlNeedLotSize.zh: 请在上方输入订单数量以计算所需样本数量及AQL标准。

aqlPreProductionNotice.en: Pre-Production Sample: formal sampling thresholds don't apply here. Check a few units by hand, at least one of each size, using the same sections below.
aqlPreProductionNotice.zh: 产前样品：此处不适用正式抽样标准。请手动检查少量样品（每个尺码至少一件），并按照下方相同的检查项目进行。

preProductionQuantityHelp.en: How many units did you physically check by hand?
preProductionQuantityHelp.zh: 您实际手动检查了多少件产品？

recommendationReferenceTitle.zh: 建议抽检比例及参考标准

actualDeterminationTitle.zh: 实际标准（根据检查件数计算）

enterActualSpotCheckFirst.en: Enter the actual spot check % below to see the real Accept/Reject thresholds that will determine pass/fail.
enterActualSpotCheckFirst.zh: 请在下方输入实际抽检比例，以查看决定合格/不合格的实际标准。

actualSpotCheckRequired.en: Actual Spot Check % is required for a Production Sample
actualSpotCheckRequired.zh: 量产样品必须填写实际抽检比例

toleranceRefSizing.en: Measurements: ±{v} cm of the approved sample.
toleranceRefSizing.zh: 尺寸：与已批准样品相差不超过 ±{v} 厘米。

toleranceRefPrint.en: Print / embroidery size and placement: ±{v} cm.
toleranceRefPrint.zh: 印花/刺绣尺寸与位置：±{v} 厘米。

actualUnitsCheckedHelp.en: Enter how many units you actually inspected. The percentage of the PO is calculated automatically.
actualUnitsCheckedHelp.zh: 请输入实际检查的件数，占订单总数的百分比将自动计算。

minorDefinition.zh: 在公差范围内——可以接受。

majorDefinition.en: Outside tolerance - that unit is rejected and sent back to the factory to fix. The rest of the batch isn't automatically rejected.
majorDefinition.zh: 超出公差范围——该件产品判定不合格，退回工厂返修。其余批次不会因此自动判定不合格。

criticalDefinition.en: The entire batch has this issue - the whole batch is rejected and must be redone. Zero tolerance.
criticalDefinition.zh: 整批产品都存在该问题——整批将被判定不合格并要求返工重做。零容忍。

moreEarlierReports.en: earlier report(s) also exist for this PO

homeReportsDesc.en: Search and download full reports by SKU
homeReportsDesc.zh: 按SKU搜索并下载完整报告

chooserHelp.zh: 请选择您要进行的操作。

chooserNewPODesc.en: Log a new PO and get a link to share for QA/QC Approval
chooserNewPODesc.zh: 创建新采购订单并获取用于质检审批的分享链接

chooserPreProdDesc.en: Inspect a small hand-checked sample before the full run
chooserPreProdDesc.zh: 在量产前对少量手动检查的样品进行检验

chooserBulkDesc.en: Inspect a spot-checked sample of the full production run
chooserBulkDesc.zh: 对量产批次进行抽样检验

asanaTaskLinkPlaceholder.en: Optional - paste the Asana task link

sizesInPoHelp.en: Select which sizes are part of this order - only these will show up later when adding photos or measurements.
sizesInPoHelp.zh: 请选择该订单包含的尺码——之后添加照片或测量数据时，只会显示这些尺码。

sizesPreFilledNote.en: Pre-filled from a previous order for this SKU - click any size to adjust.
sizesPreFilledNote.zh: 已根据该SKU的往期订单自动填充——点击任意尺码即可调整。

noEstablishedFitYet.en: No sizing standard is on file yet for this SKU. It'll be set during QA/QC Approval and copied forward automatically to future POs.
noEstablishedFitYet.zh: 该SKU尚无已建立的尺寸标准。该标准将在质检审批阶段设定，并自动应用于以后的订单。

shareLinkTitle.en: Share this link for QA/QC Approval
shareLinkTitle.zh: 请分享此链接以进行质检审批

poNotFound.en: Purchase order not found - has it been created via New Purchase Order?
poNotFound.zh: 未找到该采购订单——是否已通过“新建采购订单”创建？

priorSampleApprovalHelp.en: A completed Sample Approval already exists for this product
priorSampleApprovalHelp.zh: 该产品已有完整的样品审批记录

copiedFromPrior.en: Copied from prior PO - review and submit
copiedFromPrior.zh: 已从往期订单复制——请检查后提交

submitApprovalPhotosDesc.en: For the Juniper China team - upload photos and notes
submitApprovalPhotosDesc.zh: 供Juniper中国团队使用——上传照片和备注

approvedSizeChartHelp.en: Pre-filled with the standard - edit any values that differ on the actual sample.
approvedSizeChartHelp.zh: 已根据标准预先填写——如实际样品有差异，请修改相应数值。

simpleSizeRequired.en: Please fill in the size / measurement field
simpleSizeRequired.zh: 请填写尺寸/测量数据字段

dimensionsRequired.en: Please fill in Height, Width, and Depth
dimensionsRequired.zh: 请填写高度、宽度和深度

noIssuesInPreviousPos.en: No issues found in previous POs.
noIssuesInPreviousPos.zh: 往期订单中未发现问题。

sizingNotesRequired.en: Please add a note describing the sizing check
sizingNotesRequired.zh: 请填写尺寸检查的备注说明

customSizeRowRequired.en: Please add at least one size to the custom chart
customSizeRowRequired.zh: 请在自定义尺寸表中至少添加一个尺码

customSizeMeasurementsRequired.en: Please fill in measurements for every size in the custom chart
customSizeMeasurementsRequired.zh: 请填写自定义尺寸表中每个尺码的测量数据

clickToSelectReference.en: Click a photo or sizing row to select
clickToSelectReference.zh: 点击图片或尺寸行以选择

referenceTargetMissing.en: Can't find that anymore - it may have been replaced since this comment was written.
referenceTargetMissing.zh: 找不到该内容——自此备注发布以来，它可能已被替换。

commentRequiredFields.en: Please select your name and enter a comment
commentRequiredFields.zh: 请选择姓名并输入备注内容

sampledSizeHelp.en: The Golden Sample is only made in one size - select which size this sample represents.
sampledSizeHelp.zh: 黄金样品仅制作一个尺码——请选择该样品所代表的尺码。

sampledSizeRequired.en: Please select which size this sample represents
sampledSizeRequired.zh: 请选择该样品所代表的尺码

sharedApparelDetailsTitle.zh: 其他细节（所有尺码通用）

chinaNotesRequiredForIssue.en: Please describe the issue in the notes field

prefilledFromPoNotice.en: Filled in from the Purchase Order and QA/QC Approval - double check and edit anything that's changed.
prefilledFromPoNotice.zh: 已根据采购订单和质检审批自动填写——如有变动请检查并修改。

noPosForSku.en: No purchase orders found for this SKU.
noPosForSku.zh: 未找到该SKU对应的采购订单。

customSizeChartHelp.en: Fill in each approved size and its measurements. If it's faster, snap a photo of a paper chart below instead (or in addition).
customSizeChartHelp.zh: 请填写每个已批准的尺码及其测量数据。如果更方便，也可以在下方拍摄纸质表格照片代替（或补充）。

customSizeNamePlaceholder.zh: 例如 成人 M 码

customSizeMeasurementsPlaceholder.zh: 例如：胸围24英寸，衣长30英寸，袖长22英寸

chartPhotoHelp.en: A photo of the full approved size chart, if you have one on paper.
chartPhotoHelp.zh: 如有纸质版已批准尺寸表，请在此拍照上传。

prefilledNotice.en: Filled in from the Pre-Production report for this PO - double check and edit anything that's changed.
prefilledNotice.zh: 已根据该订单的产前样品报告自动填写——如有变动请检查并修改。

manageFitsHelp.en: Pick a standard to edit its chart, or add a new one. Values can be a single number or a range like 24-26.
manageFitsHelp.zh: 选择一个标准以编辑其尺寸表，或添加新标准。数值可以是单个数字，也可以是范围，例如 24-26。

fitKeyLabel.zh: 标识（内部使用，不含空格）

fitKeyPlaceholder.en: auto-generated from label if left blank
fitKeyPlaceholder.zh: 留空则根据名称自动生成

overallStatsTitle.zh: 总体统计（全部订单，按类别）

emptyNoNewRequests.en: No new PO requests right now.
emptyNoNewRequests.zh: 当前没有新的订单需求。

helpQaReporting.en: Share a report link with a factory or QA contact - it already knows this PO, so they can jump straight into the report. Setting a status here also moves the order along its production stages.
helpQaReporting.zh: 将报告链接分享给工厂或质检联系人 - 链接已关联此订单，可直接开始填写报告。在此设置状态也会同步推进订单的生产阶段。

helpProductDimensions.en: Loading a standard copies it in as an editable starting point - edits here only affect this PO. This becomes what QA/QC checks against for this specific order.
helpProductDimensions.zh: 载入标准后会复制为可编辑的初始值 - 此处的修改仅影响本订单，并作为该订单质检的比对依据。

emptyNoPosProduct.en: No POs recorded yet for this product.

emptyNoPosComponent.en: No POs recorded yet for this component.

emptyNoFabricPos.en: No POs have used this fabric yet.

emptyNoProductsCat.en: No products recorded yet in this category.

emptyNoComponentsCat.en: No components recorded yet in this category.

finShowingMonth.zh: 显示 {m} 的 {n} 笔订单。

finShowingAll.zh: 显示全部 {n} 笔订单，共 {c} 个月。

emptyNoSizingTable.en: No sizing table yet - select a standard above, or add sizes/points manually.
emptyNoSizingTable.zh: 尚无尺码表 - 请在上方选择标准，或手动添加尺码/测量点。

fldProductDimensionsSot.en: Product Dimensions - sizing source of truth for this PO
fldProductDimensionsSot.zh: 产品尺寸 - 本订单的尺码基准

toastThatSizeIsAlreadyInTheTable.en: That size is already in the table

confirmDeleteNamed.zh: 确定删除“{name}”？此操作无法撤销。

cliClientCreatorBrand.zh: 客户 / 创作者 / 品牌

cliNewClientPlaceholder.zh: 新客户 / 创作者 / 品牌名称...

payLineAdditionalFees.zh: 额外费用（组装/人工/其他）

phAutoFillsSupplier.zh: 根据上方供应商名称自动填充

syncFromAsanaHelp.en: Enter the PO number, then sync to pull the Creator, PD, Sourcer, SKU, quantity, fulfil date and warehouse straight from Asana.
syncFromAsanaHelp.zh: 输入采购订单号后点击同步，可直接从 Asana 拉取创作者、PD、采购负责人、SKU、数量、交付日期和仓库信息。

syncNotFound.en: No matching PO found in Asana
syncNotFound.zh: 在 Asana 中未找到匹配的采购订单

deletePoWarn.en: This permanently removes the order and its uploaded files. QA/QC reports already submitted for this PO are kept. This can't be undone.
deletePoWarn.zh: 此操作将永久删除该订单及其上传的文件。已提交的质检报告将保留。此操作无法撤销。

deletePoPrompt.en: Type the PO number to confirm:
deletePoPrompt.zh: 请输入采购订单号以确认：

deletePoMismatch.en: That doesn't match the PO number

fldSourcerOtherPlaceholder.zh: 输入新的采购负责人姓名

helpPdApproval.en: Share this link with PD and QA to run the three approval stages. Statuses below are set on that page - they're read-only here.
helpPdApproval.zh: 将此链接分享给产品开发和质检团队以完成三个审批阶段。以下状态在该页面设置，此处仅供查看。

viewPoSaveFirst.en: Save the PO first to open this component
viewPoSaveFirst.zh: 请先保存订单后再打开此组件

searchComponents.zh: 搜索部件名称、材质、供应商...

searchFabrics.en: Search code, pantone, colour, book, blend...
searchFabrics.zh: 搜索编号、潘通色号、颜色、色卡、成分...

searchSuppliers.zh: 搜索名称、编号、联系人、地址...

searchClients.zh: 搜索客户 / 创作者 / 品牌...

secSendPo.zh: 发送采购订单给供应商

helpSendPo.en: Send each factory the part of this PO they're making. Contact details come from the supplier record; anything new you enter can be saved back to it.
helpSendPo.zh: 将本订单中各自负责的部分发送给相应工厂。联系方式来自供应商档案，新填写的信息可保存回档案。

saveToSupplierRecord.en: Save this contact to the supplier record
saveToSupplierRecord.zh: 将此联系方式保存到供应商档案

noRecipientOnFile.en: No contact on file - enter one below
noRecipientOnFile.zh: 档案中无联系方式，请在下方填写

wechatNoApi.en: WeChat can't be sent automatically - copy the message and paste it to this contact.
wechatNoApi.zh: 微信无法自动发送，请复制消息后发送给该联系人。

helpMessageTemplates.en: Templates used when sending a purchase order to a supplier. The English and Chinese versions are written separately - neither is translated from the other. Use the placeholders below and they'll be filled in from the PO when you send.
helpMessageTemplates.zh: 发送采购订单给供应商时使用的模板。中英文版本分别独立撰写，互不翻译。可使用下方占位符，发送时会自动填入订单信息。

supNoVariants.en: No variant breakdown for this order.

usersHelp.en: Accounts and what each one can do. The shared site password still works and grants full access, so accounts here are additive.
usersHelp.zh: 账户及其权限。共享站点密码仍然有效并拥有完全访问权限，此处的账户为附加设置。

usersPasswordHint.en: Optional if they sign in with Google
usersPasswordHint.zh: 如使用 Google 登录则可留空

usersSupplierRequired.en: Pick which supplier this account belongs to
usersSupplierRequired.zh: 请选择该账户所属的供应商

usersNone.en: No accounts yet. The shared site password is still in use.
usersNone.zh: 暂无账户。目前仍使用共享站点密码。

usersAutoProvision.en: Anyone signing in with a Google account on an approved Juniper domain is added automatically as Juniper Team. Change their role below if they need more or less access.
usersAutoProvision.zh: 使用已批准的 Juniper 域名 Google 账户登录的人员会自动添加为「Juniper 团队」。如需调整权限，请在下方修改其角色。

helpPdApprovalLink.en: Share this link with PD, QA or a creator - it opens the approval page for this PO with no login required. Regenerate to revoke a link you've already shared.
helpPdApprovalLink.zh: 将此链接分享给产品开发、质检或创作者 - 无需登录即可打开此订单的审批页面。重新生成可撤销已分享的链接。

dispatchFromHelp.en: Who this is coming from. Email opens in your own mail client so it sends from your address; for WeChat you send it from your own account.
dispatchFromHelp.zh: 此消息的发送人。邮件将在您自己的邮箱客户端中打开并从您的地址发出；微信则由您本人的账号发送。

gmailWillSend.zh: 将直接从您的 Gmail 发送

gmailNotConnected.en: This will open your mail client.
gmailNotConnected.zh: 将打开您的邮件客户端。

gmailConnect.en: Connect Gmail to send from here instead
gmailConnect.zh: 连接 Gmail 以直接在此发送

gmailSent.zh: 邮件已从您的 Gmail 发出

supNoMatches.en: No purchase orders match those filters.
supNoMatches.zh: 没有符合筛选条件的采购订单。

gmailFellBack.en: Recorded. Gmail is not connected, so this opened your mail client - you still need to press send there.
gmailFellBack.zh: 已记录。Gmail 未连接，已打开您的邮件客户端，请在其中点击发送。

gmailOpenedClient.en: Opened in your mail client - send it from there
gmailOpenedClient.zh: 已在您的邮件客户端中打开，请从那里发送

gmailCopiedForWechat.en: Message copied - paste it into WeChat
gmailCopiedForWechat.zh: 消息已复制，请粘贴到微信

gmailSignInToSend.en: Sign in with Google to send email from inside the app.
gmailSignInToSend.zh: 使用 Google 登录后即可在应用内直接发送邮件。

gmailClientBlocked.en: Your browser blocked the mail window. Use Copy message instead.
gmailClientBlocked.zh: 浏览器阻止了邮件窗口，请改用「复制消息」。

usersWechatPrompt.en: WeChat OpenID for this user (blank to unlink):
usersWechatPrompt.zh: 该用户的微信 OpenID（留空则解除绑定）：

helpProductionNotes.en: Notes for the factory - compression, packing, anything to watch. Shown on their order page.
helpProductionNotes.zh: 给工厂的备注：压缩、包装、需要注意的事项。将显示在其订单页面。

supEditableHint.en: You can fill in the sample dates and bulk progress - they save as you type.
supEditableHint.zh: 样品日期与大货进度可由您填写，修改后自动保存。

supAddUpdateHint.en: Add a progress update - each one is saved with the date and can't be edited afterwards.
supAddUpdateHint.zh: 添加进度更新，每条记录会保存日期，提交后不可修改。

helpBulkProgress.en: Add a progress note. Each one is saved with the date and who added it, and shows on the supplier's order page.
helpBulkProgress.zh: 添加进度备注。每条记录会保存日期和填写人，并显示在供应商的订单页面。

helpProductionProgress.en: Add a progress note. Each one is saved with the date and who added it, and shows on the supplier's order page.
helpProductionProgress.zh: 添加进度备注。每条记录会保存日期和填写人，并显示在供应商的订单页面。

aqlNoQuantity.en: No recommendation yet: this PO has no order quantity set. Add the quantity on the purchase order and it will appear.
aqlNoQuantity.zh: 暂无建议：此订单未设置采购数量。请在采购订单中填写数量后即会显示。

aqlNoUnitCost.en: No recommendation yet: there is no unit cost on file for this product category. Set one in Settings, or add a factory price to the purchase order.
aqlNoUnitCost.zh: 暂无建议：该产品类别没有单位成本记录。请在设置中填写，或在采购订单中添加工厂价格。

aqlNoConfig.en: No recommendation available: the spot check configuration is missing or incomplete. Check Settings.
aqlNoConfig.zh: 无法生成建议：抽检配置缺失或不完整，请检查设置。

copyFromPriorPoFound.en: A previous PO for this SKU has an approved Golden Sample
copyFromPriorPoFound.zh: 此 SKU 的上一个订单已有已批准的初样

copyFromPriorPoHelp.en: Copies the sample photos, sizing and factory details so they don't need re-entering. Anything copied can still be changed or removed.
copyFromPriorPoHelp.zh: 复制样品照片、尺码和工厂信息，无需重新录入。复制的内容仍可修改或删除。

copyImageHelp.en: Copies a picture of the order table, plus the production notes as text. Paste it straight into WeChat.
copyImageHelp.zh: 复制订单表格图片及生产备注文本，可直接粘贴到微信。

imageCopied.en: Order image copied - paste into WeChat
imageCopied.zh: 订单图片已复制，请粘贴到微信

imageCopiedNoText.zh: 订单图片已复制（备注需单独复制）

imageCopyFailed.en: Could not copy the image - your browser may not allow it. Try Chrome.
imageCopyFailed.zh: 无法复制图片，您的浏览器可能不支持，请尝试使用 Chrome。

batchSendHelp.en: Everything not yet sent, grouped by supplier. Tick what to send, copy one image for the whole batch, then mark it sent.
batchSendHelp.zh: 尚未发送的全部内容，按供应商分组。勾选需发送的项目，复制整批图片，然后标记为已发送。

batchNothing.en: Everything has been sent to its supplier.
batchNothing.zh: 所有内容均已发送给供应商。

batchSelectSome.en: Select at least one item first

copyOrderInfoHelp.en: Copies one image containing the order table and the message. Paste it into WeChat, then mark it sent.
copyOrderInfoHelp.zh: 复制包含订单表格与消息的单张图片。粘贴到微信后，再标记为已发送。

promptExtraNotes.en: Any additional production notes to include? (leave blank for none)
promptExtraNotes.zh: 需要补充的生产备注？（如无请留空）

poImageCopied.en: PO image copied - paste into WeChat
poImageCopied.zh: 订单图片已复制，请粘贴到微信

supplierDocCopied.zh: 供应商页面链接已复制

noSupplierDoc.en: This supplier has no access link yet - create one from the Suppliers page.
noSupplierDoc.zh: 该供应商尚无访问链接，请在供应商页面创建。

notePromptHelp.en: Anything extra to include with this order. Leave blank for none.
notePromptHelp.zh: 随此订单一并发送的补充说明。如无请留空。

helpImportHandoff.en: Follows this PO's Sample Link to the handoff task and pulls in the approved sample photos and manufacturing files.
helpImportHandoff.zh: 沿此订单的 Sample Link 找到交接任务，导入已批准的样品照片与生产文件。

confirmImportHandoff.en: Import the sample photos and files from this PO's Asana handoff task?
confirmImportHandoff.zh: 确定从此订单的 Asana 交接任务导入样品照片与文件？

handoffNothing.en: Nothing was imported - see the details below.
handoffNothing.zh: 未导入任何内容，详见下方信息。

confirmReimport.en: already has files from a previous import. Re-running will replace them with a fresh copy. Continue?
confirmReimport.zh: 已有上次导入的文件。重新导入将用新副本替换它们。是否继续？

dimsFromPo.en: Taken from the purchase order. Change them in Order Management if they are wrong.
dimsFromPo.zh: 来自采购订单。如有错误请在订单管理中修改。

pickImportedHelp.en: Tap to select. These were imported from the Asana handoff, so there is no need to re-upload them.
pickImportedHelp.zh: 点击选择。这些图片已从 Asana 交接导入，无需重新上传。

pickImportedNone.en: No imported images on this PO yet. Run the Asana import from Order Management first.
pickImportedNone.zh: 此订单暂无已导入的图片。请先在订单管理中执行 Asana 导入。

handoffWillImport.en: file(s) will be imported from the Asana handoff when you submit
handoffWillImport.zh: 提交后将从 Asana 交接导入文件

btnReimportHandoff.zh: 重新从 Asana 导入文件

helpSetupReport.en: Tick anything this product includes. Each one adds its questions to an Additional Review section at the end of the report. Leave everything unticked if none apply.
helpSetupReport.zh: 勾选该产品包含的项目。每项都会在报告末尾的“附加检查”部分增加相应问题。若均不适用，可全部不选。

noteSetupInherited.en: Pre-filled from the other report stage for this PO - change anything that differs.
noteSetupInherited.zh: 已根据该订单另一阶段的设置预填充，如有不同请修改。

phCustomQuestion.zh: 请说明需要检查的内容

toastReportSetupSaved.en: Report link is ready to share

emptyNoConditionalChecks.en: No conditional checks are defined for this product category.
emptyNoConditionalChecks.zh: 该产品类别尚未设定条件检查项。

helpAdditionalReview.en: Set up for this PO because the product includes these features.
helpAdditionalReview.zh: 因该产品包含这些特性，已为本订单添加。

mediaOnFailRequired.en: Photo or video of the defect required

unitsRequiredOnFail.en: A failed question needs the number of units affected.
unitsRequiredOnFail.zh: 不合格项需填写受影响数量。

evidenceRequired.en: A photo or video is required for this question.
evidenceRequired.zh: 该项需上传图片或视频。

noQuestionsForProduct.en: No inspection questions are configured for this product type yet.
noQuestionsForProduct.zh: 该产品类型尚未配置检验问题。

additionalIssuesHelpMinor.en: Minor issues found on individual units while checking. Every section must be answered: mark it No Defects, or add one entry per distinct issue with the number of units affected.
additionalIssuesHelpMinor.zh: 检查过程中在单个产品上发现的轻微问题。每个部分均需作答：选择“无缺陷”，或每个问题单独添加一条并填写受影响数量。

recapBasisNote.en: Assumption scales what was found in the sample across the whole PO.
recapBasisNote.zh: 推算值根据抽检结果按比例推算至全单。

recapNeedsCounts.en: Enter the PO quantity and the units checked to see the whole-PO assumption.
recapNeedsCounts.zh: 请填写订单数量与已检数量，以显示全单推算。

dimensionsOutOfTolerance.en: A measurement is outside tolerance. Check it, and log a defect if it's correct.
dimensionsOutOfTolerance.zh: 有尺寸超出公差。请复核，若数值无误请记录缺陷。

helpLinkExistingFile.en: Point this row at a file already attached to the PO under Product Documentation, instead of uploading another copy.
helpLinkExistingFile.zh: 将本行指向订单“产品文档”中已有的文件，无需重复上传。

emptyNoDocsToLink.en: This PO has no Product Documentation files to link yet. Upload one there first.
emptyNoDocsToLink.zh: 该订单尚无可关联的产品文档，请先在那里上传。

toastFileLinked.en: File linked. Save the PO to keep it.
toastFileLinked.zh: 已关联文件，请保存订单。

removeIssuesFirst.zh: 请先删除已记录的问题。

sectionsUnanswered.en: Every section needs either No Defects or at least one defect logged.
sectionsUnanswered.zh: 每个部分均需选择“无缺陷”或至少记录一条缺陷。

productWeightHelp.en: Weigh a finished unit on a calibrated scale and record the weight in grams.
productWeightHelp.zh: 使用经校准的电子秤称量成品，以克为单位记录。

noApprovedWeight.en: No approved weight on the PO to compare against.
noApprovedWeight.zh: 订单上没有可对比的已批准重量。

approvedSizeChartFromPo.en: Pulled from Product Dimensions on the purchase order, which is the sizing source of truth for this PO. Edit it there if it needs to change.
approvedSizeChartFromPo.zh: 数据来自采购订单的“产品尺寸”，该表为本订单尺寸的唯一依据。如需修改请在那里调整。

noSizingTableTitle.en: No sizing reference on this PO

noSizingTableBody.en: No Golden Sample sizing table reference has been entered for this purchase order, so there is nothing to measure against. The right fix is to add it under Product Dimensions in Order Management - it then flows through to every report on this PO.
noSizingTableBody.zh: 本采购订单尚未录入金样尺寸表，因此无可对比的基准。建议在订单管理的“产品尺寸”中补充，补充后将自动应用于该订单的所有报告。

noSizingTableFallback.en: If the inspection cannot wait, you can enter a chart by hand for this report only. It will not be saved back to the PO.
noSizingTableFallback.zh: 若检验无法等待，可仅为本次报告手动录入尺寸表，该内容不会回写到订单。

manualSizingNotice.en: Entered by hand for this report only - the PO has no sizing table. Add one in Order Management so future reports do not need this.
manualSizingNotice.zh: 仅为本次报告手动录入——订单尚无尺寸表。请在订单管理中补充，以免后续报告重复录入。

noSizingTableToast.en: Add the sizing table on the PO, or choose Enter manually.
noSizingTableToast.zh: 请在订单中补充尺寸表，或选择“手动录入”。

approvalNoPoTable.en: Values entered here establish the approved chart for this sample. Adding a Product Dimensions table in Order Management instead keeps the PO and the approval in step.
approvalNoPoTable.zh: 在此录入的数值将作为本样品的已批准尺寸表。建议改为在订单管理中补充“产品尺寸”，以保持订单与审批一致。

helpLinkSourceFile.en: Paste the Google Drive link for this file. We keep a preview image for reference and leave the full file in Drive, which keeps the app small and fast.
helpLinkSourceFile.zh: 请粘贴该文件的 Google Drive 链接。系统仅保留预览图供参考，完整文件保留在 Drive，以保持系统轻量。

noteLinkSourceFile.en: No link? The full file is stored here instead. That works, but it uses far more space - only do it when the file does not live anywhere else.
noteLinkSourceFile.zh: 没有链接？则会完整保存文件。可以使用，但占用空间大得多——仅在文件无其他备份时使用。

pasteALinkFirst.en: Paste a link, or choose Upload without a link
pasteALinkFirst.zh: 请粘贴链接，或选择“不关联链接上传”

draftSaved.en: Progress saved. You can close this and come back to it.
draftSaved.zh: 已保存进度，可关闭后稍后继续。

draftSaveFailed.en: Could not save your progress - check your connection.
draftSaveFailed.zh: 无法保存进度，请检查网络连接。

draftResumed.en: Picked up where you left off.

photoUploadFailed.en: Could not upload that photo - check your connection and try again.
photoUploadFailed.zh: 图片上传失败，请检查网络后重试。

completedGateHelp.en: Open the finished report, confirm that flagged units have since been repaired, or start a separate additional report.
completedGateHelp.zh: 可查看已完成的报告、确认不合格品已修复，或新增一份独立报告。

revisedReportHelp.en: Confirm how many of the units flagged in the original report have been repaired. Every tile must be confirmed before this can be submitted.
revisedReportHelp.zh: 请确认原报告中标记的不合格品已修复的数量。所有项目确认后方可提交。

unitsFixedLabel.en: How many of these units have been repaired?

revisedSubmitFailed.en: Could not submit the revised report.

unitsFixedRange.en: Enter a number between 1 and the units flagged.
unitsFixedRange.zh: 请输入 1 至标记件数之间的数字。

noFlaggedUnits.en: The original report flagged no defective units, so there is nothing to confirm here.
noFlaggedUnits.zh: 原报告未标记不合格品，无需确认。

resultReasonThresholdCritical.en: Critical: every inspected unit was affected.
resultReasonThresholdCritical.zh: 严重：所有受检产品均存在问题。

resultReasonThresholdMajor.en: Major defect rate is above the allowed threshold.
resultReasonThresholdMajor.zh: 主要缺陷率超出允许范围。

resultReasonThresholdMinor.en: Minor defect rate is above the allowed threshold.
resultReasonThresholdMinor.zh: 轻微缺陷率超出允许范围。

dispositionHelp.en: Decide what happens to each set of defective units. Repaired and rejected units come out of the final counts; units the factory will fix stay in and need a follow-up report.
dispositionHelp.zh: 请决定每组不合格品的处理方式。现场修复与拒收的产品不计入最终统计；由工厂修复的仍计入，并需提交返修确认报告。

dispositionHelp_repaired.en: These units were fixed during the inspection, so they no longer count as defects.
dispositionHelp_repaired.zh: 这些产品已在检验期间修复，不再计入缺陷。

dispositionHelp_factory.en: These units stay in the counts. A Revised Unit Report will be needed to confirm the repair.
dispositionHelp_factory.zh: 这些产品仍计入统计，需提交返修确认报告。

dispositionHelp_rejected.en: These units will not be shipped, so they are excluded from the final quantity.
dispositionHelp_rejected.zh: 这些产品不予出货，不计入最终数量。

unitsRepairedLabel.en: How many were repaired on site?

dispositionRequired.en: Choose what happens to each set of defective units.
dispositionRequired.zh: 请为每组不合格品选择处理方式。

noDefectsToResolve.en: No defects were flagged, so there is nothing to resolve. Continue to review and submit.
noDefectsToResolve.zh: 未标记缺陷，无需处理。请继续至审核并提交。

pdfFactoryFixNote.en: Units the factory will repair remain counted. A Revised Unit Report is required to confirm the repair.
pdfFactoryFixNote.zh: 由工厂修复的产品仍计入统计，需提交返修确认报告。

twoTotalsHelp.en: As inspected is the result at the time of inspection. After repairs reflects Revised Unit Reports confirming defective units were fixed.
twoTotalsHelp.zh: “检验当时”为检验时的结果；“修复后”已计入返修确认报告中已修复的产品。

disposition_factory_pp.en: Factory will fix in bulk production
disposition_factory_pp.zh: 工厂将在大货生产中修正

dispositionHelp_factory_pp.en: The factory will correct this before the bulk run. It stays in the counts for this sample report.
dispositionHelp_factory_pp.zh: 工厂将在大货生产前修正。本次样品报告仍计入该项。

resolvedUnitsNote.en: {n} unit(s) come out of the final counts as repaired or rejected.
resolvedUnitsNote.zh: 其中 {n} 件因已修复或拒收而不计入最终统计。

checkInIntro.en: Pick a supplier to work through their open orders one at a time. Notes save as you go.
checkInIntro.zh: 选择供应商，逐单跟进其未完成订单。备注即时保存。

checkInHint.en: Ctrl+Enter saves and moves to the next order.
checkInHint.zh: Ctrl+Enter 保存并转至下一单。

qaBucketDue.en: Sample ready, no report link yet
qaBucketDue.zh: 样品已到期，尚未安排检验

qaBucketDueHelp.en: These are the ones that slip. The sample date has arrived and nothing has been scheduled.
qaBucketDueHelp.zh: 这类最易遯漏：样品日期已到，但尚未安排检验。

qaBucketPending.zh: 已安排检验，报告未提交

qaBucketPendingHelp.en: A link has been sent. Waiting on the QA team to submit.
qaBucketPendingHelp.zh: 已发送报告链接，等待质检团队提交。

qaBucketUpcomingHelp.en: Sample dates ahead. Schedule before they arrive.
qaBucketUpcomingHelp.zh: 样品日期即将到来，请提前安排。

pdWaitingOnYouHelp.en: Product Development has commented or asked for changes. Nothing moves until you reply.
pdWaitingOnYouHelp.zh: 产品开发已留言或要求修改，需你回复后才能推进。

pdWaitingOnPdHelp.en: Submitted and sitting with PD. Chase anything that has been here too long.
pdWaitingOnPdHelp.zh: 已提交至产品开发，停留过久的需跟进。

checkInIntro2.en: Work down the list. Type into Update or Follow-up as you go, then save once at the end.
checkInIntro2.zh: 逐行跟进。边打电话边填写“更新”与“跟进”，最后统一保存。

pdNeedsStartHelp.en: Nothing has been submitted yet. A new PO needs its approved sample images; a finished inspection needs submitting for approval. These sit in no other queue.
pdNeedsStartHelp.zh: 尚未提交任何内容。新订单需上传已批准样品图片；已完成的检验需提交审批。这些不会出现在其他列表中。

checkInIntro3.en: Work down the list. An update saves when you move off the box; a follow-up date saves as soon as you pick it.
checkInIntro3.zh: 逐行跟进。离开输入框即保存更新；选择跟进日期后立即保存。

checkInRequestsHelp.en: Not yet sent to this supplier. Send them before working through production.
checkInRequestsHelp.zh: 尚未发送给该供应商。请先发送，再跟进生产。

batchNothingForSupplier.en: Nothing to send for this supplier
batchNothingForSupplier.zh: 该供应商没有待发送的订单

columnsHelp.en: Pick what you want to see while working down the list. This is saved for you.
columnsHelp.zh: 选择跟进时需要显示的列。设置会为你保存。

columnsHelp2.en: Tick what you want to see, and drag to put them in the order you read them. This is saved for you.
columnsHelp2.zh: 勾选需要显示的列，并拖动调整顺序。设置会为你保存。

reportLinkCopied.en: Report link copied - the factory can open this without signing in
reportLinkCopied.zh: 报告链接已复制，工厂无需登录即可打开

pdApprovedHelp.en: Product Development has signed these off. Tick one to confirm you have seen it and it leaves the list.
pdApprovedHelp.zh: 产品开发已批准。确认已知后即从列表中移除。

pdJcHelp.en: Everything on our side: work to submit, replies Product Development is waiting for, and approvals to acknowledge.
pdJcHelp.zh: 我们这边的全部事项：待提交、待回复、以及待确认的审批。

pdSubToSubmitHelp.en: Nothing has been sent to Product Development yet.

pdSubReplyHelp.en: They have asked for changes. Nothing moves until you reply.
pdSubReplyHelp.zh: 对方要求修改，需回复后才能推进。

pdSubApprovedHelp.en: Signed off by Product Development. Tick to say you have seen it.
pdSubApprovedHelp.zh: 产品开发已批准。勾选表示已知悉。
